Malaysia in talks with rival airlines over AirAsia's financial health

Malaysia is reportedly in discussions with rival airlines as it monitors the financial health of AirAsia. The airline is said to owe Malaysia Airports Holdings Berhad at least 500 million ringgit for services such as landing and parking fees. Sources indicate these talks are ongoing.
